subject: Logic
title: Hasty Generalization
description: A fast breakdown of Hasty Generalization for builders.

hook.text: You meet one rude taxi driver and declare "all taxi drivers are rude." One sample, bold conclusion.

buildup.text: A hasty generalization draws a broad conclusion from too few examples or a biased sample.

discovery.text: Stereotypes are hasty generalizations at scale. A few bad experiences become universal judgments.

twist.text: Even scientists fall prey when sample sizes are too small or unrepresentative.

climax.text: Ask: how many cases? How diverse? How representative? If the sample is thin, so is the conclusion.
